findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_cakes" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Search Gurgaon Bakers' live cake catalogue. Use for any request to find, compare or price cakes. query: free text, e.g. "1 kg eggless chocolate truffle birthday…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_info, check_delivery · Private data: get_delivery_info, get_business_info · Public sink: get_business_info, create_checkout_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_info, check_delivery · Private data: get_delivery_info, get_business_info · Public sink: get_business_info, create_checkout_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
